title: ExecutionEventEnvelopeV1
description: Frozen contract (PLAN v3.0 §3.3). Outbound from window B: produced by the Projection Actor for each Nautilus order/position/account event and delivered to the control-plane. event_id is the idempotency key; duplicate WS events and reconciliation replays must not double-apply.

event_id.description: Stable, unique, deterministic per source event. Used as the projection idempotency key.

event_type.description: Nautilus-derived event type, e.g. OrderSubmitted, OrderAccepted, OrderFilled, OrderCanceled, OrderRejected, OrderExpired, PositionOpened, PositionChanged, PositionClosed, AccountState.

payload.description: Controlled summary of the original Nautilus event (no exchange secrets).
